NAME

compression_workspace_t

SYNOPSIS

#include <include/ascii-chat/network/compression.h>

Data Fields


void * codec
buffer_workspace_t output

Detailed Description

Zero-initialized worker-owned zstd context and reusable output storage. Output is borrowed until the next call or destruction; never queue it without copying. The caller serializes access to the workspace.
